# BC Observatory: code changes

> Merged pull requests of Microsoft's Business Central code (microsoft/BCApps) that touch AL source: what changed, in our words,
> joined by exact file path to the AL object pages. Tier official, metadata only. Frontmatter: schemas/frontmatter.change.json.

1083 changes, newest first.

- [#12198 [29.x]Source Currency Inconsistency for LCY Postings and cash posting on sales documents](bcapps/12198.md): Fixes inconsistent Source Currency values on G/L entries for LCY postings and for cash posting on sales documents. The fix changes Gen. Jnl.-Post Line in the W1 layer and several localized layers in the 29.x release. (releases/29.x, 2026-10-08, fix)
- [#12306 Warn before releasing a purchase order that was already sent electronically](bcapps/12306.md): A warning now appears when releasing a purchase order that was already electronically sent, preventing silent re-export of the same e-document with the same identifier that would later cause conflicts. (main, 2026-10-07, feature)
- [#2392 AL-Go Telemetry Enhancements: repository fork and hosting information](al-go/2392.md): AL-Go telemetry now captures whether a repository is a fork and its GitHub hosting type (GitHub.com, GHEC, or GHES), helping distinguish workflows across different environments without sending server details to telemetry. (main, 2026-10-07, feature)
- [#12078 [29.x]Reduce allocations in the "Export to Execl" scenario (#11870)](bcapps/12078.md): The Export to Excel scenario now allocates significantly less memory by reusing a CellDecorator instance, eliminating redundant ExcelBuf record calculations, and reducing method call overhead during column processing. (releases/29.x, 2026-10-07, performance)
- [#11629 Fix Norwegian SAF-T 1.30 export issues](bcapps/11629.md): Norwegian SAF-T 1.30 export now correctly reports header versions, handles credit amounts as non-negative, excludes unselected dimensions from the XML, and counts transaction groups consistently across split files. (main, 2026-10-07, fix)
- [#12428 Add Copilot feature trial interface](bcapps/12428.md): Added a public Copilot feature trial interface to System Application, enabling applications to initiate trials, query remaining quota, and consume trial usage with corresponding implementation codeunits and tests. (main, 2026-10-07, feature)
- [#10446 [Bug][Subscription Billing] "Subscription Lines - Overdue" cue counts lines of contracts that already ended](bcapps/10446.md): Fixed the Overdue Subscription Lines cue and page to exclude subscription lines that have been billed past their term end date, eliminating false positives in the overdue count and improving accuracy by checking billing progress rather than relying on a stale flag. (main, 2026-10-07, fix)
- [#10212 Add SetReferenceType method to SignedXml and SignedXmlImpl (#10139)](bcapps/10212.md): A SetReferenceType method is added to the SignedXml codeunit to allow callers to set the Type property on XMLDSIG Reference elements, enabling creation of XML signatures with typed references such as references to XAdES SignedProperties. (main, 2026-10-07, feature)
- [#12463 Fix Email upgrade writing during no-transaction upgrade test](bcapps/12463.md): Email Installer no longer re-registers email tables based on allowed-table row presence, only checking upgrade tags or forced refresh to prevent unwanted database writes during upgrade tests. (main, 2026-10-07, fix)
- [#11560 [E-Documents Core] [Peppol] - Enabling EDI capabilities with E-Documents. Send path (Self-Billed Purchase Invoice/Credit Memo → E-Document)](bcapps/11560.md): Enables exporting self-billed purchase invoices and credit memos as Peppol BIS 3.0 e-documents, with automatic type assignment based on vendor self-billing agreements and new manual creation actions on posted purchase pages. (main, 2026-10-07, feature)
- [#12207 [MCP] Prepare Data Query Tools for billing](bcapps/12207.md): Data Query Tools for MCP are now marked billable with a pricing acknowledgement requirement before activation. When imported, users are prompted to confirm pricing; headless imports default to disabled. (main, 2026-10-07, feature)
- [#11959 [Master]-Production Order Fails to Finish Due to Quantity Rounding Difference Between Component Consumption and Item Tracking Quantity - Copy](bcapps/11959.md): Production orders now correctly handle quantity rounding differences between component consumption and item tracking quantities to prevent finish failures. (main, 2026-10-07, fix)
- [#12064 Support SharePoint paths containing hash and percent characters](bcapps/12064.md): SharePoint connector now supports file paths containing hash and percent characters by adding separate decoded-path APIs backed by ResourcePath endpoints, with a new REST Base Folder Path Format setting to control URL decoding behavior. (main, 2026-10-07, feature)
- [#12135 Fix Reverse Charge VAT upgrade migration](bcapps/12135.md): Corrected field mappings and filtering logic in the Reverse Charge VAT upgrade migration to properly transfer legacy values into new GB fields using type-correct filters. (main, 2026-10-06, fix)
- [#12215 [Shopify] Link grouped invoice to all originating orders](bcapps/12215.md): Invoice document linking to Shopify orders now correctly associates a single invoice with all originating Shopify orders when multiple shipments are grouped, instead of retaining filters from earlier shipments. (main, 2026-10-06, fix)
- [#12214 [Shopify] Store currency handling for auto-created orders](bcapps/12214.md): The Shopify connector now persists the currency handling mode used during order processing to the Shopify order record, ensuring the stored value reflects the actual mode applied to the created sales document even if the shop configuration changes during synchronization. (main, 2026-10-06, fix)
- [#10772 [Bug Fix] #304: [SOA] Re-resolve new sender to created contact after 'I have added the contact'](bcapps/10772.md): Sales Order Agent now correctly re-resolves sender information to the newly created contact after a user adds a contact in the chat, allowing the agent to proceed instead of reporting the customer cannot be found. (main, 2026-10-06, fix)
- [#12325 [Expense tests] Re-enable reviewed APIs and consolidate Expense fixes](bcapps/12325.md): Expense Agent API tests are re-enabled. Eleven Expense API and helper paths move to shared authentication, 51 Expense API exclusions are removed, and nine non-API exclusions stay. Clean test codeunit execution is turned on, and 193 temporary API exclusions are added to the existing APIV1 and APIV2 manifests. (main, 2026-10-06, fix)
- [#12118 Fix Email Inbox retention policy failing on missing indirect Read permission](bcapps/12118.md): Email Inbox retention policy no longer fails due to missing indirect read permission and now registers the table for existing tenants through an upgrade tag. (main, 2026-10-06, fix)
- [#12261 Stop repeated rescheduling of Dataverse synch jobs on bulk changes](bcapps/12261.md): The Dataverse synchronization job reschedule logic now checks both the scheduled task's next run time and the job queue entry's earliest start date to avoid repeated rescheduling during bulk changes, reducing unnecessary Service Bus costs. (main, 2026-10-06, fix)
- [#12309 Fix infinite recursion in Config. Package Field XML name generation](bcapps/12309.md): Fixed infinite recursion in XML element name generation when configuration package fields produce duplicate XML names by replacing recursion with a bounded loop that appends counters and properly shortens base names. (main, 2026-10-06, fix)
- [#12188 [Master]-Reserved quantities do not match the expected quantities after planning - regression due to correction](bcapps/12188.md): Fixes a regression, caused by an earlier correction, where reserved quantities did not match the expected quantities after planning. The change is in the Mfg. Invt. Profile Offsetting codeunit and comes with new tests. (main, 2026-10-06, fix)
- [#9347 Fix IssueDate in E-Documents for Germany](bcapps/9347.md): Fixed the IssueDate field in German E-Document exports (XRechnung and ZUGFeRD formats) to ensure correct date handling. (main, 2026-10-06, fix)
- [#2395 Prevent workflow telemetry failures from failing the workflow](al-go/2395.md): WorkflowPostProcess telemetry failures no longer cause the entire workflow to fail, allowing GitHub API errors during finalization to remain visible in logs without blocking successful builds. (main, 2026-10-06, fix)
- [#12370 Guard removed Manufacturing Setup fields with CLEANSCHEMA30 preprocessor](bcapps/12370.md): Manufacturing Setup fields marked as removed in version 30.0 are wrapped with preprocessor guards to comply with ObsoleteTag rules and match existing conventions in the file. (main, 2026-10-06, fix)
- [#12139 [Shopify] Disable Create Sales Documents for empty order views](bcapps/12139.md): The Create Sales Documents action on the Shopify Orders page is now disabled when the current filtered view contains no orders, preventing users from attempting to create documents with no data. (main, 2026-10-06, fix)
- [#12320 Fix 409 conflict in APIV2 Company Info E2E description test](bcapps/12320.md): Fixed 409 conflict errors in APIV2 Company Info E2E tests by disabling test isolation to allow commits to take effect, and changed Environment Information reads to no longer write the singleton record. (main, 2026-10-06, fix)
- [#214 UI knowledge: notification recall needs a known Id; open mixed-type documents through Page Management](bcquality/214.md): Two new UI design guidance articles added to help developers properly manage notifications by using known IDs for recall and handle multi-document routing through Page Management instead of hard-coded mappings. (main, 2026-10-06, feature)
- [#208 2 AL/BC patterns: TableRelation field length and RecordRef.Open Temp parameter](bcquality/208.md): Two new knowledge articles identify silent runtime mismatches in table relations and record reference calls that compile without diagnostic warnings. The articles explain the exact rules for field length matching and the pitfalls of using RecordRef.Open with the temporary parameter flag. (main, 2026-10-06, feature)
- [#12304 [Master]-Page cannot open because of FlowField 'Last Run By User'](bcapps/12304.md): Fixes a problem where a financial reports page could not open because of the FlowField 'Last Run By User'. The change touches the Financial Report and Financial Report Audit Log tables and the Financial Reports and Acc. Schedule Overview pages. (main, 2026-10-06, fix)
- [#12260 [Shopify] Fix shop card transaction navigation](bcapps/12260.md): The Shopify Shop Card payment transaction navigation now opens the correct transaction list and filters by the Shop field instead of the obsolete Shop Code FlowField. (main, 2026-10-06, fix)
- [#11848 [main] Report 11564, Foreign Currency Layout: foreign currency opening balance is not included](bcapps/11848.md): Report 11564 now correctly includes foreign currency opening balances for G/L accounts with multiple registered source currencies, fixing previously understated running FCY balances. (main, 2026-10-06, fix)
- [#12290 Remove CLEAN27 from Service Management](bcapps/12290.md): Removes code that had been kept behind the CLEAN27 symbol in Service Management across W1 and many localization layers. This deletes obsolete ES and IT pages and codeunits for updating posted service invoices and shipments and strips the related code from service tables, pages, page extensions, reports and codeunits. (main, 2026-10-06, refactor)
- [#12143 Bug 649440: [Subcontracting] [IT] Disable Legacy Subcontracting leaves Component Supply Method empty after conversion](bcapps/12143.md): The Italian subcontracting legacy migration now correctly maps the vendor's procurement setting to the component supply method for both production BOM lines and existing production-order components during conversion. (main, 2026-10-06, fix)
- [#12145 [Main]-Item charge assignment update Error on sales order when there is no Price. "Sorry, we just updated this page. Reopen it and try again." when running in SaaS](bcapps/12145.md): Fixed an error on sales orders when assigning item charges by amount when some item lines have no price. The assignment record set is now refreshed after bulk updates to prevent stale data issues. (main, 2026-10-06, fix)
- [#12307 Make UpgradeDefaultDimensions ParentId backfill set-based (via DataTransfer)](bcapps/12307.md): The UpgradeDefaultDimensions procedure now uses set-based DataTransfer operations instead of row-by-row processing to backfill ParentId fields in Default Dimension records, significantly reducing upgrade runtime on large tables. (main, 2026-10-05, performance)
- [#12055 [E-Documents Core] Show error for unmatched inbound Order Response](bcapps/12055.md): Unmatched inbound PEPPOL Order Responses now produce a descriptive error and remain visible in the E-Document list instead of being silently deleted. (main, 2026-10-05, fix)
- [#11604 fix: capture Shopify fulfillment deliveredAt timestamp](bcapps/11604.md): The Shopify connector now captures and displays the fulfillment delivery timestamp from Shopify, enabling users to see when shipments were actually delivered. A new field stores the deliveredAt value, the GraphQL query requests it, and the import logic parses it across both order fetches and shipment exports. (main, 2026-10-05, feature)
- [#12059 [Master]-Reverse Production Entry fails when production output is posted using a non-base Unit of Measure.](bcapps/12059.md): Reversing a production entry no longer fails when the production output was posted using a non-base unit of measure. The fix is in the Undo Prod. Posting Mgmt. codeunit. (main, 2026-10-05, fix)
- [#12062 [Master]-[Quality Management] Workflow events are not localized](bcapps/12062.md): Workflow event labels in the Quality Management app are now properly localized for international users. (main, 2026-10-05, fix)
- [#11637 [Master]- Create Documents on Recurring Billing ignores the Partner filter and fails when a vendor billing proposal exists](bcapps/11637.md): Create Documents in Recurring Billing now respects the Partner filter and no longer fails when a vendor billing proposal exists. The fix is a small change in the Create Billing Documents codeunit, with new tests. (main, 2026-10-05, fix)
- [#11994 [Master]- [Planning Worksheet] Production Copy to Req. Wksh fails because destination fields are missing](bcapps/11994.md): Copying production planning lines to a requisition worksheet through the Carry Out Action Msg. - Plan. report no longer fails because of missing destination fields. The report now fills in the needed fields, and a new test covers the scenario. (main, 2026-10-05, fix)
- [#12256 [Payables Agent] Exclude agent accounts from eligible users](bcapps/12256.md): Automatic user selection in Payables Agent Setup now skips users with the Agent license type. Before this, saving the setup or activating the agent could fail when an agent account had created a posted purchase invoice in the last 30 days, because the platform rejects an agent configuring another agent. (main, 2026-10-05, fix)
- [#12141 [Master]-Incorrect project ledger costs when non-deductible VAT is posted to a foreign-currency project](bcapps/12141.md): Fixed incorrect project ledger costs when posting non-deductible VAT to a foreign-currency project by correcting currency conversions in the non-deductible VAT implementation. (main, 2026-10-05, fix)
- [#9953 Rename AppSource UI text to Marketplace](bcapps/9953.md): User-facing text that references AppSource has been updated to use Marketplace terminology throughout the application and system components. (main, 2026-10-05, other)
- [#12255 Fix overwrite import of exported system permission sets](bcapps/12255.md): System permission set imports with overwrite option now correctly delete permissions and relations that differ from the imported file, instead of merging silently. The fix handles both system and tenant format files, with tenant format now using exact role ID matching. (main, 2026-10-05, fix)
- [#10182 [Bug]: [Subscription Billing] Payment discount on contract invoices comes from the customer, not from the contract's payment terms](bcapps/10182.md): Payment discount percentages on subscription billing invoices now correctly use the contract's payment terms instead of the customer or vendor's payment terms. (main, 2026-10-05, fix)
- [#177 Add retention policy knowledge to the privacy domain](bcquality/177.md): Added guidance to the privacy domain in BCQuality about registering extension-owned tables for retention policies and shipping default retention policy setups, addressing common mistakes in how extensions handle log table cleanup. (main, 2026-10-05, feature)
- [#12097 [29.X]-[Quality Management] Workflow events are not localized](bcapps/12097.md): Workflow event labels in the Quality Management module are now properly localized instead of showing hardcoded English text. (releases/29.x, 2026-10-05, fix)
- [#218 Harden findings-report producer constraints](bcquality/218.md): Findings reports now enforce stricter validation rules for finding IDs, confidence levels, and severity values to prevent contract failures. Finding IDs must not contain citation fragments, uncited findings are restricted to medium/low confidence and minor/info severity, and a checklist clarifies proper handling of citation paths and line numbering. (main, 2026-10-05, fix)
- [#213 knowledge(events): database trigger setup flags may only be set to true](bcquality/213.md): Adds a knowledge article and review check: subscribers to GetDatabaseTableTriggerSetup (Global Triggers) or OnAfterGetDatabaseTableTriggerSetup (codeunit 49) should only set the shared trigger flags to true. Assigning false or a lookup result can clear flags that other features or apps rely on. (main, 2026-10-05, feature)
- [#215 knowledge(performance): grouped query (Count + ColumnFilter = HAVING) for distinct values and duplicates](bcquality/215.md): A new performance knowledge article teaches developers how to use query objects with grouped methods and column filters to detect duplicate values in a single SQL statement instead of looping with multiple queries. (main, 2026-10-05, feature)
- [#209 3 AL/BC patterns: Insert/Delete trigger defaults on master data and declined Confirm in OnValidate](bcquality/209.md): Three new articles guide developers to use triggers when writing or deleting master data and to properly abort validations when user confirmation is declined. (main, 2026-10-05, feature)
- [#216 knowledge(style): a new procedure that changes the page's current record should take it as var Record](bcquality/216.md): New style guidance document for AL developers on when procedures that modify a record should take the record as a var parameter, with good and bad code samples and exclusions. (main, 2026-10-05, feature)
- [#12124 Fix default bin assignment when creating purchase orders for drop shipments](bcapps/12124.md): Fixed default bin assignment for drop shipments when creating purchase orders from sales orders. The requisition line no longer incorrectly receives a default bin during item validation when the drop-shipment flag is set. (main, 2026-10-05, fix)
- [#11259 Postcode Configuration Page: display the stored provider selection on open](bcapps/11259.md): The Postcode Configuration Page now displays the currently stored provider selection when opened, preventing the configured value from being cleared when closing the page with OK. (main, 2026-10-05, fix)
- [#11129 [Quality Management] Refactor permission management](bcapps/11129.md): Quality Management now uses standard permission errors instead of custom table permission checks, simplifying permission management while maintaining administrator-only access controls. (main, 2026-10-05, refactor)
- [#9180 Copy record links to posted Phys. Invt. Order and Recording headers](bcapps/9180.md): Record links attached to physical inventory order and recording headers are now copied to their posted documents, matching the behavior of sales, purchase, and warehouse posting flows. (main, 2026-10-05, fix)
- [#10799 Remove OnPrem scope from Table 1226 "Payment Export Data".SetSwissExport](bcapps/10799.md): The SetSwissExport procedure on the Payment Export Data table is now callable from Cloud extensions by removing its OnPrem scope restriction, making it consistent with other setters and the SwissExport field itself. (main, 2026-10-05, fix)
- [#12242 29.x: Removing the restriction of deploying Power BI reports only to evaluation companies](bcapps/12242.md): Power BI report deployment is no longer limited to evaluation companies; deploying to My workspace still is. The setup wizard now lets you pick a workspace, and the workspace name is recorded at deployment time and shown in the deployments list. (releases/29.x, 2026-10-05, feature)
- [#12152 [MCP] Clear environment description after environment copy](bcapps/12152.md): Environment descriptions are now cleared when an environment is copied, preventing the destination from retaining information about the source environment. (main, 2026-10-05, feature)
- [#12213 [Financial Reports] Add row and column definition preview](bcapps/12213.md): Financial report row and column definitions now include preview capability. Users can set a counterpart definition on each report definition and quickly preview how the row or column layout renders. (main, 2026-10-05, feature)
- [#12293 Remove CLEAN27 from Warehouse](bcapps/12293.md): Removes code guarded by CLEAN27 from warehouse codeunits, tables and a report in the Base Application. Elements obsoleted earlier are now deleted, so extensions still using them must be updated. (main, 2026-10-05, obsoletion)
- [#12127 [AT] VAT Statement report doesn't print the 4.9% VAT rate columns on the U30 Form](bcapps/12127.md): The VAT Statement report for Austria now correctly includes 4.9% VAT rate columns on the U30 PDF form, fixing a gap in the original implementation. (main, 2026-10-05, fix)
- [#11748 [Master] - Slice 626292: [Excise Tax][VENDOR] Bonded Locations for Excise Calculations](bcapps/11748.md): Excise tax calculation now handles bonded-location scenarios for suspended-duty transfers, with logic that determines when transfers from bonded to non-bonded locations are subject to excise tax. (main, 2026-10-05, feature)
- [#10347 [Bug][Subscription Billing] Wrong number of days on vendor contract deferrals when the billing period lies within a single calendar month](bcapps/10347.md): Vendor subscription contract deferrals now calculate the correct number of days when a billing period falls entirely within a single calendar month, fixing day counts that previously extended to the month's end. (main, 2026-10-03, fix)
- [#10210 [Bug][Subscription Billing] "Delete Invoiced Sales Orders" leaves orphaned Sales Subscription Lines behind](bcapps/10210.md): Fixed orphaned Sales Subscription Lines left behind by "Delete Invoiced Sales Orders" and "Delete Invd Blnkt Sales Orders" reports by adding event subscribers and batch deletion procedures on the Sales Header table extension. (main, 2026-10-02, fix)
- [#8429 E-Document DE: map Payment Method to PEPPOL payment means codes, add SEPA Direct Debit export support](bcapps/8429.md): Payment methods can now be mapped to standard PEPPOL payment means codes, enabling SEPA Direct Debit support in German E-Document formats with automatic fallback to SEPA credit transfer for compatibility. (main, 2026-10-02, feature)
- [#12196 [Master Data Management] Disable cross-env setup action OnPrem and fix field visibility issues](bcapps/12196.md): Master Data Management cross-environment setup action is now disabled for on-premises installations and field visibility is corrected to display cross-environment details properly on the setup page. (main, 2026-10-02, fix)
- [#9438 SL - Add support for migrating historical project transactions](bcapps/9438.md): A new migration setting enables historical project transactions to be migrated alongside other historical data during SL migration, making project history a first-class migration option. (main, 2026-10-02, feature)
- [#12074 Expense Agent: travel request expense location, per-traveler reports, activity log and submitter comment](bcapps/12074.md): The Expense Agent travel request feature now supports expense location selection using per diem rules, creates per-traveler expense reports on approval, logs the full request lifecycle, enables rejection with automatic reopen, and allows submitter comments for resubmissions. (main, 2026-10-02, feature)
- [#12189 Removing the restriction of deploying Power BI reports only to evaluation companies](bcapps/12189.md): Power BI report deployment now works with regular companies, not just evaluation companies. Workspace selection is integrated into the deployment wizard, and the workspace name is tracked and displayed in deployment history. (main, 2026-10-02, feature)
- [#12066 Bugs/remove asm inv mfg clean27 tags for wave2 2026](bcapps/12066.md): Removes the obsolete code that was kept under CLEAN27 conditional compilation in assembly, inventory, manufacturing and planning objects of the Base Application, its localization layers, and the Subcontracting, Sustainability and CZ Advanced Localization Pack apps. (main, 2026-10-02, obsoletion)
- [#12167 Track QuickBooks migration usage consistently](bcapps/12167.md): QuickBooks migration now consistently tracks usage by adding an uptake telemetry event and backfilling historical migrations with completed status during upgrade. (main, 2026-10-02, feature)
- [#205 Preserve business filters when recommending Record.Get](bcquality/205.md): The performance guidance for replacing FindFirst with Record.Get now clarifies that additional business filters must be preserved, either by keeping the filtered FindFirst or by enforcing equivalent conditions after Get. (main, 2026-10-02, fix)
- [#12194 Harden web request helpers: opt-in default credentials](bcapps/12194.md): Http Web Request Mgt. and SOAP Web Service Request Mgt. now disable default credentials by default and require callers to opt in with SetUseDefaultCredentials(true) for on-premises installations, preventing unintended transmission of Business Central service account credentials to external hosts. (main, 2026-10-02, breaking)
- [#12117 [Job Queue] Clearer message and attempt number for runs interrupted by the platform](bcapps/12117.md): When the platform interrupts a job queue run, the log entry message now says the run was interrupted by a service restart or update, shows the attempt number, and says a retry is scheduled. The existing 0000PCR telemetry signal gets a JobQueueInterruptedAttempt dimension. (main, 2026-10-02, feature)
- [#10755 Migrate Http Web Request Mgt. callers to native HttpClient](bcapps/10755.md): Six callers, including currency exchange rate updates, external accountant invitations, JSON structure retrieval, OData metadata download and the Microsoft 365 E-Document GraphClient, now use native AL HTTP types instead of the legacy Http Web Request Mgt. codeunit. A new CreateMetadataRequest procedure is added while the old CreateMetadataWebRequest stays for compatibility. (main, 2026-10-02, refactor)
- [#210 knowledge(upgrade): upgrade code must not use ChangeCompany](bcquality/210.md): New quality rule and knowledge article prevent upgrade code from using ChangeCompany, which can cause data races, duplicate upgrades, and trigger misexecution in the calling company context. (main, 2026-10-02, feature)
- [#204 Validate composed reviews against the expected leaf worklist](bcquality/204.md): The findings-report validator gets an optional expected-composition manifest. It checks that selected leaves, versions, result order and legitimate skips match what the host chose. Duplicate producers are now rejected, and a composition with missing leaves must be reported as partial or failed instead of completed. (main, 2026-10-02, feature)
- [#207 2 AL/BC UI patterns: client-expression in-list (AL0573) and Role Center AccessByPermission](bcquality/207.md): Two new UI knowledge articles were added. One covers in-list set-membership tests in client expressions such as Visible or Enabled on actions, groups and parts, which only raise warning AL0573. The other covers using AccessByPermission for permission gating on Role Centers, where triggers and procedures are not allowed. (main, 2026-10-02, feature)
- [#203 knowledge(data-modeling): Prices Including VAT decides the basis of sales/purchase/service line amounts](bcquality/203.md): A knowledge article clarifies how the Prices Including VAT header flag affects the basis of line amount fields in sales, purchase, and service documents, distinguishing fields that follow the flag from those with fixed net or gross basis. (main, 2026-10-02, feature)
- [#12206 Track C5 migration usage consistently](bcapps/12206.md): C5 2012 migration now emits standard cloud migration telemetry events for feature uptake, completion, and abort tracking, plus a one-time upgrade backfill for historical usage. (main, 2026-10-01, feature)
- [#11628 Expense Agent: capture submission policy evaluation history](bcapps/11628.md): Expense Agent now captures policy evaluation history at the report level, storing outcomes and flagged categories in the activity log during submission and resubmission with deduplication per submission round. (main, 2026-10-01, feature)
- [#12140 [Email - SMTP Connector] Fix OAuth Base64URL token parsing](bcapps/12140.md): OAuth2 SMTP authentication now correctly decodes Base64URL tokens by normalizing them to standard Base64 before parsing, fixing intermittent authentication failures when JWT payloads contain URL-safe characters. (main, 2026-10-01, fix)
- [#11899 [Shopify] Tax matching fixes for country, Canadian HST, and zero-rate lines](bcapps/11899.md): The Shopify Tax Matching Agent now runs only for US and Canadian orders. It scopes Canadian HST/TVH jurisdictions by province, matches zero-rate tax lines, and holds orders as Tax Match Incomplete when a tax line is left without a jurisdiction. The matching prompt rules were also made consistent. (main, 2026-10-01, fix)
- [#11854 [Shopify] Make refund currency codes read-only](bcapps/11854.md): Currency Code and Presentment Currency Code fields on the Shopify Refund Header table are now read-only to prevent accidental modification of imported Shopify data. (main, 2026-10-01, fix)
- [#11866 [Shopify] Disable Sync Shipments To Shopify when no Shopify orders exist](bcapps/11866.md): The Sync Shipments To Shopify action on the Shopify Orders page is now disabled when no applicable Shopify orders exist. The check honors the Shop Code filter from the Shop Card and ignores other page filters, so a visually empty page does not wrongly disable the action. (main, 2026-10-01, fix)
- [#11654 Repair and re-enable Expense Agent permission and posted-history tests](bcapps/11654.md): Expense Agent tests were repaired and re-enabled. The fixes cover permission checks, posted-history fixtures and foreign-currency fixtures, and 14 exclusions were removed from the disabled-test manifest. The Travel Requests API page was also adjusted, and HTTP API test exclusions stay in place. (main, 2026-10-01, fix)
- [#12157 Mark GetAddress.io objects as obsolete](bcapps/12157.md): GetAddress.io UK postcode app objects are marked obsolete. Its page extensions and the test app were removed, and the remaining tables, pages, codeunits and permission set extensions now carry obsolete markings. The app is already uninstalled from tenants as of 28.3. (main, 2026-10-01, obsoletion)
- [#11941 Bug 651577 CompAuxNum and CompAuxLib columns should be informed for Payment Discount lines on Unapplied Entries in the French Audit File.](bcapps/11941.md): The FEC audit file export now populates CompAuxNum and CompAuxLib columns for payment discount lines on unapplied entries by using G/L entry source type and number as a fallback when customer/vendor ledger entries are unavailable. (main, 2026-10-01, fix)
- [#12061 [Master] - Bug 651754: Expense Management - Captions and ToolTips update](bcapps/12061.md): Expense Management pages now display improved captions and tooltips to provide users with clearer and more accurate field descriptions. (main, 2026-10-01, fix)
- [#11889 [Master] - Bug 651129: Expense Agent - Distance UOM in Configuration](bcapps/11889.md): Expense Agent setup now includes distance unit of measure configuration, enabling users to specify the unit of measure for mileage expense calculations. (main, 2026-10-01, feature)
- [#11314 [Project Arches] Microsoft Fabric Export Setup](bcapps/11314.md): New Microsoft Fabric Export functionality allows Business Central to export data to Microsoft Fabric with setup pages, configuration packages, and platform management capabilities. (main, 2026-10-01, feature)

- [#9313 [Shopify] Fix Product Sync deleting mapped variants on stale Updated At timestamp](bcapps/9313.md): The Shopify variant sync now correctly distinguishes between variants that have stale local timestamps (should be kept) and variants deleted on Shopify (should be removed), preventing incorrect deletion of mapped variants during asynchronous bulk operations. (main, 2026-07-13, fix)
